title: Kidney, adrenal and urinary tract

steps.tx: The **Bosniak classification** 2019 categorizes cystic **renal masses** into five progressive risk strata: Bosniak I (simple cyst), II (minimally complicated benign), IIF (minimally complex requiring follow-up), III (indeterminate, approximately 50% malignant), and IV (clearly malignant cystic mass with enhancing solid nodules requiring prompt surgical intervention).

steps.tx: **Clear cell renal cell carcinoma** comprises approximately 70% of RCC cases, demonstrating intense, heterogeneous hypervascular enhancement on corticomedullary CT acquisitions. Microscopic intracellular lipid produces characteristic signal dropout on out-of-phase **chemical shift** MRI sequences compared with in-phase imaging, reflecting abundant clear cytoplasm filled with cholesterol and neutral lipids.
steps.say: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma comprises approximately 70% of RCC cases, demonstrating intense, heterogeneous hypervascular enhancement on corticomedullary CT acquisitions. Microscopic intracellular lipid produces characteristic signal dropout on out-of-phase chemical shift MRI sequences compared with in-phase imaging, reflecting abundant clear cytoplasm filled with cholesterol and neutral lipids.

left.title: Clear Cell RCC (70%)
points: Marked avid corticomedullary enhancement (> 100 HU)
Intracellular lipid signal drop on chemical shift MRI
Heterogeneous necrosis, cystic change, calcification
Propensity for renal vein and IVC tumour thrombus
Associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease

right.title: Papillary RCC (15%)
points: Hypovascular, progressive subtle enhancement
T2 hypointense appearance on MRI
Homogeneous appearance when small
Frequently multifocal and bilateral
Associated with MET oncogene mutations

steps.tx: Renal **angiomyolipoma** classic type contains abundant **macroscopic fat** demonstrating attenuation values below negative 20 Hounsfield units on non-contrast CT scans. Composed of abnormal dysplastic blood vessels, smooth muscle, and mature adipose tissue, AML is strongly associated with tuberous sclerosis complex when multiple and bilateral.
steps.say: Renal angiomyolipoma classic type contains abundant macroscopic fat demonstrating attenuation values below negative 20 Hounsfield units on non-contrast CT scans. Composed of abnormal dysplastic blood vessels, smooth muscle, and mature adipose tissue, AML is strongly associated with tuberous sclerosis complex when multiple and bilateral.

rows: Attenuation below negative 20 HU, chemical shift drop
Aneurysmal dilatation without internal elastic lamina
Risk of rupture and Wunderlich syndrome
Soft tissue attenuation and solid enhancement

steps.tx: **Emphysematous pyelonephritis** is a life-threatening necrotizing gas-forming bacterial infection occurring in diabetics, characterized by gas within the **renal parenchyma** on CT. Imaging distinguishes type 1 (dry parenchymal necrosis with streaky gas) from type 2 (bubbly gas with fluid collections and abscesses).
steps.say: Emphysematous pyelonephritis is a life-threatening necrotizing gas-forming bacterial infection occurring in diabetics, characterized by gas within the renal parenchyma on CT. Imaging distinguishes type 1, which has dry parenchymal necrosis with streaky gas, from type 2, which has bubbly gas with fluid collections and abscesses.

left.title: Type 1 Emphysematous Pyelonephritis
points: Parenchymal destruction with streaky radial gas
Absence of purulent fluid collections (dry necrosis)
Fulminant clinical course with high mortality (40%)
Impaired vascular supply in uncontrolled diabetes
Requires emergent nephrectomy or aggressive drainage

right.title: Type 2 Emphysematous Pyelonephritis
points: Bubbly gas within loculated fluid collections
Presence of perirenal or subcapsular abscesses
Gas within renal collecting system (emphysematous pyelitis)
Better host response with lower mortality (15%)
Amenable to percutaneous catheter drainage

steps.tx: **Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis** can manifest as chronic destructive granulomatous parenchymal infection triggered by chronic pelvi-ureteric bacterial obstruction. Contrast-enhanced CT characteristically demonstrates the pathognomonic **bear paw sign**, featuring multiple rounded low-attenuation caliceal fluid collections radiating outward from an obstructing central staghorn calculus.

rows: Dilated calyces filled with xanthoma pus
Complete loss of excretory function on delayed phases
Perinephric fat stranding and psoas fistulae

steps.tx: On unenhanced CT, benign **Adrenal adenoma** demonstrates attenuation of 10 Hounsfield units or less due to intracytoplasmic lipid. On dynamic contrast washout CT, adenomas display rapid clearance with an absolute **percentage washout** of 60% or more, or relative percentage washout of 40% or more at 15 minutes.
steps.say: On unenhanced CT, benign Adrenal adenoma demonstrates attenuation of 10 Hounsfield units or less due to intracytoplasmic lipid. On dynamic contrast washout CT, adenomas will display rapid clearance with an absolute percentage washout of 60% or more, or relative percentage washout of 40% or more at 15 minutes.

steps.tx: Adrenal **Pheochromocytoma** follows the classical 10% rule: 10% bilateral, 10% extra-adrenal, 10% malignant, and 10% familial syndromes. On T2-weighted MRI, pheochromocytomas exhibit marked hyperintensity known as the **lightbulb sign** alongside avid, heterogeneous contrast enhancement and extensive internal cystic or necrotic degeneration.

steps.tx: **Adrenocortical carcinoma** typically presents as a large, aggressive mass measuring greater than 5 cm in diameter. CT demonstrates prominent internal necrosis, haemorrhage, peripheral nodular enhancement with sluggish washout, and coarse **calcifications** present in up to 30% of cases alongside venous invasion.
steps.say: Adrenocortical carcinoma typically presents as a large, aggressive mass measuring greater than 5 centimetres in diameter. CT demonstrates prominent internal necrosis, haemorrhage, peripheral nodular enhancement with sluggish washout, and coarse calcifications present in up to 30% of cases alongside venous invasion.

left.title: Adrenocortical Carcinoma Features
points: Large mass size exceeding 5 cm diameter
Coarse internal calcifications in 30% of cases
Extensive central necrosis and haemorrhage
Sluggish contrast washout on delayed CT
Direct invasion of renal vein and IVC

right.title: Lipid-Rich Adrenal Adenoma
points: Small, well-circumscribed mass (< 4 cm)
Homogeneous low attenuation (<= 10 HU)
Absence of calcifications or gross necrosis
Rapid contrast washout (>= 60% APW)
Absence of local organ or vascular invasion
